name: Star Wars Resistance
description: Kazuda Xiono, a young pilot for the Resistance, is tasked with a top secret mission to investigate the First Order, a growing threat in the galaxy.

videos.title: The Search for Kaz
videos.overview: BB-8 goes on an adventure and tries to find Kaz!

videos.title: Dart and Cover
videos.overview: Kaz and Bucket’s game goes awry as they try and impress their pals!

videos.title: Neeku's Reward
videos.overview: Neeku's food gets away from him in the marketplace!

videos.title: When Thieves Drop By
videos.overview: It's a bad idea to try and rob Flix & Orka!

videos.title: Treasure Chest
videos.overview: Flix & Orka try and open a chest with disastrous results!

videos.title: G-LN
videos.overview: There’s a reason why Cantinas don’t serve droids!

videos.title: Bucket's Quest
videos.overview: When Bucket loses his helmet, he’ll do anything to get it back!

videos.title: Unmotivated
videos.overview: Flix & Orka try and fix Hype’s broken, angry droid!

videos.title: The Need for Speed
videos.overview: The Aces race to compete for Hype’s top spot!

videos.title: Sixty Seconds to Destruction
videos.overview: The Aces band together to stop a crashing ship!

videos.title: Buggle's Day Out
videos.overview: Kaz gets in trouble when he tries to take care of Buggles!

videos.title: The Rematch
videos.overview: Kaz and Torra try and test the Fireball’s thrusters!

videos.title: The Recruit
videos.overview: X-wing pilot Kazuda Xiono is recruited for the Resistance, but finds himself in over his head when Poe Dameron assigns him to a remote fueling station to spy on the First Order. Then, after Kaz boasts about being the best pilot around, he is forced to compete in a dangerous sky race.

videos.title: The Triple Dark
videos.overview: Kaz and BB-8 uncover information on an imminent pirate attack and must find a way to stop it.

videos.title: Fuel for the Fire
videos.overview: Kaz befriends a sky racer named Rucklin who pressures him to take some rare and dangerous hyperfuel hidden in Yeager’s office.

videos.title: The High Tower
videos.overview: The First Order arrives at the platform for mysterious reasons and Kaz and BB-8 are determined to sneak into the tower to find out what they want.

videos.title: The Children from Tehar
videos.overview: Kaz searches for two missing children for a sizeable reward only to discover the First Order is also hunting for them.

videos.title: Signal from Sector Six
videos.overview: When out on a routine training exercise, a distress signal sends Kaz and Poe to a damaged ship with strange lifeforms onboard.

videos.title: Synara's Score
videos.overview: On a mission to repair a vital platform defense, Kaz befriends the mysterious Synara and comes under attack by pirates.

videos.title: The Platform Classic
videos.overview: An upcoming race reunites Yeager with his estranged brother, Marcus, who needs to win to pay off his debt to a criminal organization.

videos.title: Secrets and Holograms
videos.overview: When a determined Kaz tries to discover the truth about Captain Doza, he and Torra embark on an adventure where they uncover more about the tower than either bargained for.

videos.title: Station Theta Black
videos.overview: When Poe and Kaz find an old First Order mining facility, BB-8 discovers the facility isn’t so abandoned.

videos.title: Bibo
videos.overview: Neeku adopts a strange sea creature and gets way more than he bargained for when it brings chaos to the platform.

videos.title: Dangerous Business
videos.overview: In exchange for parts, Kaz minds Acquisitions for Flix and Orka and comes into conflict with a shady alien customer in league with the First Order.

videos.title: The Doza Dilemma
videos.overview: Synara settles into life on the platform, but her pirate compatriots have other plans for her.

videos.title: The First Order Occupation
videos.overview: Kaz scrambles to help Synara escape the platform as the First Order sends a contingent of stormtroopers to hunt a spy.

videos.title: The New Trooper
videos.overview: When Kel and Eila seek out Kaz’s help after knocking out a stormtrooper, Kaz dons the trooper’s armor to protect the kids and spy on the First Order.

videos.title: The Core Problem
videos.overview: Poe and Kaz make an unsettling discovery and must evade the First Order when they are spotted by an enemy probe droid.

videos.title: The Disappeared
videos.overview: Kaz and Torra investigate the disappearance of a friend and plan to free them from the First Order.

videos.title: Descent
videos.overview: With secrets exposed, Yeager's crew must evade relentless troopers hunting them down and find a way to reach the Resistance.

videos.title: No Escape (1)
videos.overview: Kaz, Neeku, Torra devise a plan to free their friends, but it’s upended when Kaz bears witness to the full might of the First Order.

videos.title: No Escape (2)
videos.overview: With Neeku’s help, Kaz comes up with a risky plan to rid the Colossus of the First Order once and for all.

videos.title: Into the Unknown
videos.overview: After being launched into space by Kaz and crew, the Colossus encounters engineering problems, which are made worse by a mysterious stowaway.

videos.title: A Quick Salvage Run
videos.overview: With the Colossus in need of hyperfuel, Kaz suggests they take it from a downed First Order ship, but the salvage mission is quickly compromised when the First Order shows up.

videos.title: Live Fire
videos.overview: Kaz officially joins the Aces, as does Yeager -- who trains them to become better combat pilots. Tam learns what it's like to be a First Order pilot.

videos.title: Hunt on Celsor 3
videos.overview: The pirates volunteer to find food for the Colossus, but Kaz doesn't trust them. Kaz and Torra go on the hunt, but run into big problems.

videos.title: The Engineer
videos.overview: Kaz and Neeku discover Nena, a Nikto engineer in need of assistance who barely escaped a First Order attack.

videos.title: From Beneath
videos.overview: Flix takes Kaz and crew to his home world to acquire fuel from his family's refinery, only to discover the family's drilling has awoken something monstrous.

videos.title: The Relic Raiders
videos.overview: When Kaz and team arrives on a mysterious planet to buy supplies, they find the outpost has been abandoned and a secret Sith Temple has been raised.

videos.title: Rendezvous Point
videos.overview: Doza attempts to meet a Resistance pilot from his past, but the pilot has been captured by the First Order.

videos.title: The Voxx Vortex 5000
videos.overview: With the Colossus running out of money, Hype risks everything by taking the Aces to race at Vranki's Casino, run by Vranki the Hutt.

videos.title: Kaz's Curse
videos.overview: A pirate curses Kaz, causing him danger at every turn. Kaz is soon forced to seek Mika Grey for help, but Kaz's curse gets worse when the Guavian Death Gang appears.

videos.title: Station to Station
videos.overview: Kaz and Neeku sneak onto a First Order refueling station in order to take an important piece of tech. Plans go awry when they run into Tam and General Hux.

videos.title: The Missing Agent
videos.overview: Kaz, Yeager and Synara trace a distress call to a planet where a Resistance agent has gone missing. Things only get worse as a mysterious bounty hunter starts hunting them.

videos.title: Breakout
videos.overview: Kaz and Norath try to help their friends while being pursued by a deadly bounty hunter.

videos.title: The Mutiny
videos.overview: Kragan buys a secret weapon to capture the Colossus and take over. When Synara discovers this plan, she tries to warn Kaz and crew, but it may be too late.

videos.title: The New World
videos.overview: Doza takes the Colossus to a hidden world on the outer rim, only to find it’s inhabited by beings who don’t like them.

videos.title: No Place Safe
videos.overview: Kaz decides to join up with Poe and the Resistance, but things go awry when he discovers the First Order has located the Colossus.

videos.title: Rebuilding the Resistance
videos.overview: Resistance recruits need an escort getting off of Dantooine, but, unfortunately, Tam is assigned to destroy the recruits.

videos.title: The Escape
videos.overview: Kaz and Yeager attempt to rescue Tam from the First Order while trying to evade capture on a Star Destroyer. Meanwhile, the Colossus is in trouble and faces an impossible choice.

awards: Nominated for 2 Primetime Emmys. 1 win & 4 nominations total
